test_title: PYST 20: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank.

Taking the summer job proved to be ________ for Anand’s visa applications.
solution:
The correct answer is: a blessing in disguise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"a blessing in disguise"** means something that seems bad or unlucky at first but results in something good happening later. (एक छुपा हुआ वरदान)

 
 
• **Example:** Losing that job was actually **a blessing in disguise**; it pushed me to pursue my true passion.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: On the contrary** (इसके विपरीत): Means the opposite of what has been stated.

 
 
• **Example:** Some people think she is unfriendly; **on the contrary**, she is just shy.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: Come up** (होना या घटित होना): To happen or occur, especially unexpectedly.
 
 
• **Example:** I can't attend the meeting because something urgent has **come up**.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: Come in high** (उच्च में आना): This phrase does not fit the context of the sentence.

3c:Tb2c,

The correct answer is: **Option 1**.
